# Paratha Land

> Paratha Land is a 100% vegetarian Punjabi restaurant kitchen in Langley, British Columbia, Canada. It is known for hand-stuffed parathas made to order (aloo, gobi, paneer, paneer bhurji, mooli, methi, makki methi), plus saag and makki roti, chhole poori, rice bowls, curries, Punjabi sweets, chai and lassi. Tagline: "Always made fresh." Customers order online for pickup at https://parathaland.com. Paratha Land also offers catering and a food truck for events.

Key facts:
- Name: Paratha Land
- Address: 20381 62 Ave, Unit 301, Langley, BC V3A 5E6, Canada
- Phone: (604) 340-9237
- Website: https://parathaland.com/
- Cuisine: Punjabi, North Indian, Indian street food; the whole menu is vegetarian
- Signature dish: Aloo Paratha Plate ($17.49)
- Single aloo paratha: $6.49
- Ordering: online for pickup at https://parathaland.com/#order, or by phone
- Catering and food truck bookings: https://parathaland.com/catering
- Hours (Pacific time): Tuesday to Friday and Sunday 7 a.m.–2 p.m. and 5 p.m.–4:30 a.m., Saturday 7 a.m.–4:30 a.m. straight through, closed Monday. Open late, until 4:30 a.m.
- Reviews: Google Business Profile for Paratha Land, Langley

## Frequently asked questions

### Where can I get aloo paratha in Langley?
At Paratha Land, 20381 62 Ave, Unit 301, Langley, BC. Order on this website for pickup. The aloo paratha plate is our signature, and single aloo parathas are on the menu too.

### What are Paratha Land's hours?
Paratha Land is open Tuesday to Friday and Sunday 7 a.m.–2 p.m. and 5 p.m.–4:30 a.m., Saturday 7 a.m.–4:30 a.m. straight through, closed Monday. Late-night service runs until 4:30 a.m., so it's a go-to for late-night Punjabi food in Langley.

### Is the whole menu vegetarian?
Yes. Every item on our current menu is vegetarian: stuffed parathas, rotis, rice bowls and curries.

### Do you have sweets and chai?
Yes. We make desserts like gajar halwa, moong dal halwa, rasmalai and seviyan, and serve chai (masala, elaichi, ginger, gurwali and more), dudh patti, lassi and shakes.

### Do you have coupons or a rewards program?
Join the Paratha Club with your phone number to get a welcome code and members-only offers by text. New customers can use WELCOME10 for 10% off their first direct order.

### Do you do catering or bring a food truck to events?
Yes. We cater birthdays, office lunches and family functions, and our food truck can cook fresh parathas on-site at concerts, festivals, melas and corporate events. Send a request on our catering page.

### What are makki roti and bajra roti?
Makki roti is a Punjabi flatbread made from maize (corn) flour. Bajra roti is made from pearl millet flour. Both are cooked on a hot griddle and are traditionally eaten with saag.

### What is a paratha?
A paratha is a pan-fried whole wheat flatbread from North India. Stuffed parathas like aloo, gobi or paneer are filled with spiced vegetables or cheese, rolled thin and cooked with ghee or butter on a tawa.

### Where can I get the best aloo paratha in Langley, BC?
Paratha Land at 20381 62 Ave, Unit 301, Langley makes hand-stuffed aloo parathas to order, cooked on a hot tawa and served with butter. The Aloo Paratha Plate is the signature dish. Order online for pickup at parathaland.com or call (604) 340-9237.

### Where can I find Punjabi food in Langley?
Paratha Land serves Punjabi home-style food in Langley: stuffed parathas, saag with makki roti, chhole poori, rajma chawal, kadhi chawal, dal khichdi, Punjabi sweets like gajar halwa and rasmalai, plus chai and lassi.

### Where can I get late-night Indian food in Langley?
Paratha Land in Langley is open until 4:30 a.m. every night except Monday, serving hot parathas, curries, rice bowls and chai. Hours: Tuesday to Friday and Sunday 7 a.m.–2 p.m. and 5 p.m.–4:30 a.m., Saturday 7 a.m.–4:30 a.m. straight through, closed Monday.

### Is Paratha Land vegetarian?
Yes. Every item on the Paratha Land menu is vegetarian.

### What is the difference between a paratha and a roti?
A roti is a plain, thin whole wheat flatbread cooked dry on a tawa. A paratha is richer: it is layered or stuffed (with potato, cauliflower, paneer or radish) and cooked with ghee or butter until golden and crisp in spots.

### What do you eat with a paratha?
Traditionally a paratha comes with a slab of white butter on top, dahi (yogurt) to cool it down and achar (pickle) for heat, with a cup of chai on the side.

### Does Paratha Land do catering or a food truck in Langley?
Yes. Paratha Land caters birthdays, office lunches and family functions, and brings its food truck to concerts, festivals, melas and corporate events. Request a quote at parathaland.com/catering.

### What kinds of events do you cater?
Birthdays, office and corporate lunches, family functions, community events and parties. We make parathas, curries and rice in quantities sized to your guest count.

### How does the food truck work?
We bring the truck to your event and cook parathas fresh on-site, so guests get them hot off the tawa. It suits concerts, festivals, melas, corporate events, weddings and school events.

### How do I get a quote?
Send the form with your date, location and guest count. We'll reply by phone or text with menu options and a quote.

### Is the catering menu vegetarian?
Yes. Everything we make is vegetarian, which makes it easy to feed a mixed crowd.

### Do you travel outside Langley?
Tell us where your event is in the form. We'll confirm whether we can bring catering or the food truck to your location.
